messages: You have a strange dream about sharks.
Your dreams give you a strange damp, finned feeling.
You dream of swimming through vast undersea canyons.
In your dream you catch a glimpse of a shark tail while swimming.
You have a vivid dream of hunting in the deep ocean, sensing every ripple and vibration.
The ruins of an ancient underwater city shimmer in your dream, and it feels like home.
You glide through the water with effortless grace, the apex predator of this drowned world. The surface seems so far away now.
Atlantis beckons you home.  Its marble spires and coral gardens feel more real than the waking world.
You dream of leading a school of sharks through the flooded ruins of New England.  'a', you say to them, and they understand.
